strix_halo.description: Self-hosted Strix Halo runners. The default pool: every skill that is not listed in `skills` below runs here, on both Linux and Windows.

instinct.description: Self-hosted MI300X runners (Linux, ROCm, Docker). Scarce shared hardware, and the job reads an Anthropic key from the `behavioral-instinct` environment rather than the internal AMD gateway, so assigning a skill here grants it both.
